title: Kummer OQ-01-OQ-01: Multinomial Carry Valuation
description: Records the Lean bridge from multinomial p-adic valuation to a sum of binomial Kummer carry-count valuations.

problemStatement.formal: Express the p-adic valuation of a multinomial coefficient as the sum of binomial factorization valuations arising from the telescoping product.
problemStatement.plain: Turns the multinomial version of Kummer's theorem into a verified Lean bridge: multinomial valuations are reduced to the Kummer theorem for binomial coefficients.
whyMatters: It connects multinomial divisibility questions to Mathlib's binomial Kummer theorem.
The proof explains how the telescoping product controls the valuation without adding axioms.
Concrete multinomial checks provide regression examples for the formal carry-count story.

proven: `factorization_list_prod` proves factorization additivity over nonzero list products.
`multinomial_factorization_is_sum_of_binomial_factorizations` gives the valuation bridge for multinomials.
`multinomial_kummer` states the carry-count interpretation through Mathlib's binomial Kummer theorem.
`KummerTheoremOQ01OQ01.lean` is recorded with 0 axioms and 0 sorries.
open: A standalone base-p carry formalism for multinomials remains a broader library direction.
The file relies on the existing binomial Kummer theorem rather than rebuilding the full carry theory from scratch.
knownResults.goal: Expose the completed multinomial valuation bridge while keeping the larger carry-formalism gap explicit.
